**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Structural Steel inspector** **- Saudi National** to join our team!

The Structural Steel Inspector will be responsible for inspecting and monitoring all structural steel fabrication, erection, installation, welding, bolting, and associated activities to ensure compliance with approved drawings, project specifications, applicable codes and standards, Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs), and client requirements.

The role will work closely with the Quality team, Structural Engineers, Construction teams, contractors, fabrication facilities, third-party inspectors, and consultants to ensure that structural steel works meet the required quality, safety, dimensional, and technical standards from fabrication through final installation and handover.

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Inspect structural steel fabrication and erection activities in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, ITPs, and method statements.
* Review and verify approved shop drawings, fabrication drawings, material specifications, and erection drawings.
* Conduct inspections at fabrication yards and project sites as required.
* Verify structural steel materials against approved material submittals and specifications.
* Review Material Test Certificates (MTCs), Mill Certificates, Certificates of Conformity, and other material documentation.
* Verify steel grades, sizes, thicknesses, dimensions, heat numbers, and material traceability.
* Inspect steel fabrication activities including cutting, drilling, forming, fit-up, assembly, and preparation.
* Inspect welding activities and verify compliance with approved Welding Procedure Specifications (WPS) and applicable requirements.
* Verify welder qualifications and ensure welding is performed by approved and qualified personnel.
* Monitor pre-welding preparations, joint fit-up, alignment, preheating, welding parameters, and post-weld requirements.
* Coordinate and witness Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) including UT, MT, PT, RT, and visual inspection as applicable.
* Review NDT reports and verify that results meet specified acceptance criteria.
* Inspect bolted connections, including bolt type, grade, size, installation, tightening, and torque/tension requirements.
* Verify installation of high-strength structural bolts and associated connection components.
* Conduct dimensional inspections of fabricated and erected steel structures.
* Verify structural steel alignment, level, plumbness, tolerances, elevations, and connection geometry.
* Inspect surface preparation, blasting, cleaning, and coating application.
* Verify paint/coating systems, DFT requirements, environmental conditions, and coating inspection records.
* Inspect fireproofing / fire protection systems applied to structural steel where applicable.
* Verify anchor bolts, base plates, embedded items, and steel-to-concrete interfaces.
* Monitor erection activities and ensure temporary stability and approved erection procedures are maintained.
* Review lifting and erection activities from a quality and technical inspection perspective.
* Coordinate with Structural Engineers regarding technical issues, deviations, and field modifications.
* Raise and monitor Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), Site Inspection Requests (SIRs), and Quality Observations where required.
* Verify implementation and closure of corrective actions related to structural steel works.
* Prepare inspection reports, checklists, photographs, and quality records.
* Maintain accurate inspection and material traceability documentation.
* Witness and document required hold points, witness points, and inspection activities in accordance with approved ITPs.
* Review contractor quality documentation and ensure required records are complete and traceable.
* Participate in fabrication inspections, pre-shipment inspections, site inspections, and final acceptance inspections.
* Verify structural steel works against applicable AISC, AWS, ASTM, ASME, BS, EN, ISO, and project-specific requirements, as applicable.
* Support quality audits and provide objective evidence of inspection and compliance.
* Monitor punch-list items and verify satisfactory completion before final acceptance.
* Support preparation of as-built records, inspection dossiers, welding documentation, NDT records, coating reports, and final handover documentation.
* Coordinate with commissioning and handover teams where structural steel works interface with mechanical, electrical, architectural, or specialist systems.
* Identify potential quality issues at an early stage and provide recommendations to prevent rework.
* Promote quality awareness and compliance among contractors and fabrication teams.

**What Required Skills You'll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 5+ years of relevant experience in structural steel inspection, fabrication, erection, or construction quality control.
* Proven experience on major airport, infrastructure, industrial, commercial, or large-scale construction projects.
* Strong knowledge of structural steel fabrication, welding, bolting, erection, coating, and inspection requirements.
* Experience working with structural steel fabricators, contractors, consultants, and third-party inspection agencies.
* Good understanding of drawings, specifications, ITPs, welding documentation, and inspection procedures.

* AWS Certified Welding Inspector (CWI) is highly preferred.
* CSWIP Welding Inspector certification is an advantage.
* NDT qualifications such as UT, MT, PT, or RT are advantageous.
* NACE / AMPP Coating Inspector certification is an advantage.
* ISO 9001 Internal Auditor / Quality certification is preferred.
* Relevant professional engineering certification is an advantage.

**What Desired Skills You'll Bring:**

**Job Description:**

Parsons are recruiting for an exceptionally talented **Service Charges & Revenue Director: Estate Management, City Assets Management** to join their team.

The Service Charges & Revenue Director will take ownership of the city-wide service charge framework, service charge model, charging methodologies, cost recovery governance, revenue opportunity evaluation and associated assurance activities across the Estate Management function. The role is accountable for coordinating operational, financial and asset-management inputs required to support service charge governance and commercial sustainability, whilst providing recommendations for leadership review and approval.  Minimum 20 years experience.

**Job Description**

The Service Charges & Revenue Director is responsible for establishing, owning and maintaining the city-wide service charge framework, governance model, charging methodologies and revenue optimization strategy across the city operating model.

The role provides coordination and assurance across Estate Management, City Operations, Asset Management, Finance, districts, operators and delivery teams to ensure that operational costs, common area services and shared infrastructure are appropriately understood, fairly allocated and recoverable where applicable. The Director acts as the custodian of the city-wide service charge model, leading cost allocation governance and city-wide revenue opportunity assessment to support long-term operational sustainability, financial resilience and value optimization.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Establish and maintain the city-wide service charge framework, governance structure, policies, methodologies and operating principles across applicable assets, facilities, services and districts.
* Develop and maintain service charge allocation principles, recharge methodologies, cost categorization structures and governance requirements.
* Ensure service charge arrangements are transparent, equitable, auditable and aligned with approved operational and commercial objectives.
* Lead annual service charge review processes, including governance controls, methodology updates and assurance requirements.
* Prepare policy recommendations on service charge methodologies and governance arrangements for leadership review and approval.
* Ensure service charge approaches remain aligned with operating models, asset ownership structures, operational responsibilities and district requirements.
* Promote consistency in charging practices and cost recovery principles across the wider operating model.
* Provide leadership reporting on service charge governance effectiveness, risks, issues and improvement opportunities.
* Own and maintain the city-wide service charge model and its supporting governance arrangements.
* Coordinate inputs from Asset Management, City Operations, Finance, districts, operators and external advisors to ensure model integrity, consistency and reliability.
* Review and challenge charging assumptions, allocation methodologies, cost drivers and model outputs to support robust decision making.
* Ensure common area services, shared infrastructure, public realm assets and city-wide services are accurately reflected within service charge calculations.
* Maintain transparent assumptions, supporting evidence and governance records for all significant model decisions.
* Monitor model effectiveness and ensure assumptions evolve in line with city growth, asset commissioning and operational maturity.
* Develop management information, dashboards and reporting outputs to support leadership review and decision making.
* Support periodic reviews of service charge affordability, allocation fairness and cost recovery effectiveness.
* Lead the identification and evaluation of revenue-generating opportunities associated with assets, infrastructure, facilities, services and common areas.
* Assess emerging opportunities that support operational sustainability and maximize value from owned or managed assets.
* Coordinate commercial evaluations of potential revenue streams, recovery mechanisms and value-generation initiatives.
* Develop business case inputs, financial assessments and strategic recommendations for leadership consideration.
* Ensure revenue opportunities are evaluated against operational requirements, customer experience expectations and long-term strategic objectives.
* Maintain visibility of revenue-generating initiatives across districts, operators and asset portfolios.
* Monitor market developments and emerging trends that may create future revenue opportunities.
* Provide evidence-based recommendations regarding revenue generation, value optimization and cost recovery enhancement.
* Coordinate operating expenditure inputs with City Operations, operators, Finance and Asset Management stakeholders.
* Ensure service charge assumptions appropriately reflect approved service levels, operational requirements and operating delivery models.
* Work closely with lifecycle planning and integration stakeholders to incorporate lifecycle forecasts, renewal obligations and long-term asset funding requirements into service charge considerations.
* Ensure lifecycle cost impacts and renewal pressures are visible during service charge reviews and cost recovery assessments.
* Coordinate discussions regarding maintenance obligations, service standards, lifecycle exposure and cost allocation assumptions.
* Challenge cost assumptions where opportunities exist to improve efficiency, affordability or value for money.
* Support integrated planning through clear visibility of operational expenditure, lifecycle obligations and recovery opportunities.
* Promote alignment between operational sustainability objectives and cost recovery strategies.
* Maintain a consolidated view of operational costs, service charge assumptions, recovery methodologies and cost allocation structures.
* Review cost recovery performance and identify variances, risks, affordability issues, recovery gaps and potential revenue leakage.
* Coordinate assurance activities relating to service charge calculations, allocation methodologies and recovery assumptions.
* Provide recommendations to improve transparency, accountability and effectiveness of cost recovery arrangements.
* Support leadership reporting on cost recovery performance, service charge outcomes and operational affordability pressures.
* Monitor trends, exceptions and performance indicators to identify emerging risks and improvement opportunities.
* Ensure service charge arrangements remain sustainable and support long-term operational and financial objectives.
* Develop governance reporting and performance dashboards covering cost recovery effectiveness and financial resilience.
* Build strong working relationships with districts, operators, City Operations, Asset Management, Finance and governance stakeholders.
* Coordinate stakeholder engagement activities associated with service charges, revenue generation and cost recovery initiatives.
* Facilitate discussions on operating assumptions, service levels, allocation methodologies, charging structures and recovery mechanisms.
* Ensure district and operator requirements are captured, reviewed and appropriately reflected within service charge governance arrangements.
* Support resolution of service charge and cost allocation issues through structured engagement, analysis and recommendations.
* Promote transparency and understanding of charging methodologies and governance requirements across stakeholders.
* Support senior leadership engagement on financially significant recovery, charging and revenue matters.
* Facilitate cross-functional reviews of emerging operational, commercial and cost recovery challenges.
* Define scopes, deliverables, acceptance criteria and performance requirements for consultants supporting service charge and revenue initiatives.
* Manage consultant activities, outputs, recommendations and reporting requirements.
* Review benchmarking studies, financial assessments, charge methodologies, governance recommendations and commercial evaluations.
* Ensure consultant outputs are evidence-based, practical and aligned with Estate Management objectives.
* Coordinate independent reviews and specialist assessments as required to support decision making.
* Escalate significant findings, risks, opportunities and recommendations to senior management where appropriate.
* Translate consultant recommendations into practical governance improvements and decision-support outputs.
* Promote effective knowledge transfer and capability development through external specialist engagements.
* Promote continual improvement of service charge governance, cost recovery methodologies and revenue opportunity assessment processes.
* Coordinate benchmarking exercises through specialist consultants to compare service charge practices, cost recovery arrangements and revenue opportunities against relevant market comparators.
* Monitor industry developments, regulatory changes, operational trends and emerging practices that may impact service charge or revenue strategies.
* Develop dashboards, management reports and executive briefings covering service charge performance, revenue opportunities and recovery effectiveness.
* Review governance effectiveness and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, transparency and value creation.
* Support the development of Estate Management capability through guidance, workshops, governance routines and stakeholder engagement.
* Maintain lessons learned and continuous improvement processes for service charge and revenue management activities.
* Promote evidence-based decision making through high-quality reporting and performance analysis.

**What Required Skills You'll Bring;**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Real Estate, Asset Management, Business Administration, Commercial Management or a related discipline.
* Master’s degree in a relevant discipline is preferred.
* Professional certification or membership in finance, service charge management, commercial management, asset management, real estate or business management is desirable.
* Minimum 20 years of progressive experience in service charges, commercial management, cost recovery, financial planning, real estate operations, asset management, infrastructure operations or related disciplines, including senior leadership experience.
* Proven experience developing, managing or governing service charge models and cost allocation methodologies within complex multi-stakeholder environments.
* Experience evaluating revenue opportunities, commercial initiatives, cost recovery strategies and financial sustainability programs.
* Experience coordinating operational, asset management and finance stakeholders to develop evidence-based commercial recommendations.
* Experience managing consultants, specialist advisors and commercial studies.
* Experience supporting executive-level decision making through financial modelling, governance reporting and commercial analysis.
* Experience within large-scale destinations, cities, infrastructure programs, mixed-use developments, public realm environments or giga-projects is strongly preferred.

**What Desired Skills You'll Bring;**

* Background in service charge governance, estate management, property management, commercial management, infrastructure finance, revenue optimization or operational finance.
* Practical exposure to city operations, asset management, operational readiness, lifecycle planning and cost recovery environments.
* Experience working across finance, operations, asset management and governance functions to support sustainable operating models and commercial outcomes.

**Technical & Functional Skills**

* Service charge governance, allocation methodologies and cost recovery frameworks.
* Financial analysis, business case development and commercial evaluation.
* Revenue opportunity identification, assessment and value optimization.
* Operating expenditure analysis and multi-stakeholder coordination.
* Lifecycle cost integration and long-term operational sustainability considerations.
* Benchmarking, assurance reviews, performance reporting and governance controls.
* Consultant management, commercial oversight and executive-level reporting.
* Cross-functional stakeholder engagement and complex decision support.

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **DLP & Snagging Engineer (Saudi National)** to join our team!

The DLP & Snagging Engineer is responsible for the technical identification, coordination, tracking and close-out of defects, snags and Defects Liability Period (DLP) obligations across assigned assets. The role provides engineering-focused support for DLP and snagging activities, working closely with project teams, consultants, contractors, service providers and internal stakeholders, and ensuring that defects are recorded, assessed, prioritized, rectified, evidenced and closed in line with contractual obligations, handover requirements, operational standards and client expectations.

  

This position supports asset handover, operational readiness and the transition into steady-state operations by ensuring that defects do not compromise safety, statutory compliance, maintainability, service continuity or user/guest experience.

* Deliver day-to-day DLP and snagging engineering support across assigned assets, ensuring defects, incomplete works and operational readiness issues are clearly identified, technically assessed, logged, prioritised and progressed towards closure.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Traffic Signal Systems Expert** to join our team! In this role, you will provide senior technical leadership for the assessment, planning, design, optimization, integration, operation, and performance monitoring of advanced traffic signal systems supporting a major urban traffic management program. You will lead the technical evaluation of existing signal infrastructure, adaptive control strategies, controller configurations, detection systems, communications, priority and preemption functions, and central system interfaces, with a clear focus on measurable network performance.

You will be the central technical authority for traffic signal systems across the program — ensuring that signal operations are safe, coordinated, data-driven, and operationally realistic. You will work closely with traffic engineering, ITS, Traffic Control Center (TCC) operations, field maintenance, system vendors, and agency stakeholders to align traffic signal systems around a consistent, standards-based, and performance-driven operating model.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Lead technical assessments of existing traffic signal systems, including controller hardware, cabinet configurations, detection systems, communications, central-system interfaces, timing databases, and operational procedures.
* Provide expert direction on adaptive signal control strategies, including system configuration, operating parameters, corridor progression, congestion response, queue management, and performance monitoring.
* Review and optimize traffic signal timing plans, phasing sequences, cycle lengths, offsets, splits, clearance intervals, pedestrian timings, transit priority logic, and emergency vehicle preemption settings.
* Evaluate the performance of multiple signal control platforms and advise on the practical application, limitations, integration needs, and operational readiness of each platform within the agency environment.
* Lead the development of technical standards, guidelines, procedures, and checklists for traffic signal design, controller programming, detection placement, adaptive operations, signal maintenance, and field commissioning.
* Review traffic signal design packages, controller specifications, system architecture documents, testing plans, contractor submittals, and as-built documentation for technical completeness and operational suitability.
* Diagnose recurring signal operations issues, including split failures, detector failures, ineffective coordination, unnecessary recalls, poor progression, excessive queues, and inconsistent controller settings across corridors or districts.
* Define requirements for Automated Traffic Signal Performance Measures (ATSPM), high-resolution controller data, dashboards, alerts, and reporting tools that support continuous signal operations improvement.
* Work with ITS and systems integration teams to confirm that traffic signal systems properly interface with ATMS platforms, detection systems, CCTV/video analytics, AVL systems, traveler information tools, and incident response workflows.
* Support the implementation and tuning of public transport signal priority, Bus Rapid Transit signal operations, freight corridor coordination, pedestrian priority, and emergency vehicle preemption in a way that balances priority movements with overall network performance.
* Establish practical field testing, commissioning, verification, and acceptance procedures for new or modified signal installations, adaptive control deployments, detection upgrades, and central-system integrations.
* Lead technical workshops with agency staff, vendors, contractors, designers, operators, and maintenance teams to resolve signal system issues, confirm standards, and build consistent operating practices.
* Mentor client staff and project team members on traffic signal operations, adaptive signal concepts, controller logic, troubleshooting methods, performance analytics, and day-to-day TCC use of signal management tools.
* Provide input to project plans, risk registers, implementation schedules, quality reviews, and performance frameworks to ensure traffic signal system activities are properly planned, tracked, and delivered.
* Contribute to monthly, quarterly, and final reports by summarizing signal system progress, operational findings, risks, decisions, performance results, and recommended next actions.
* Act as a visible champion for proactive signal operations, helping shift the agency from reactive maintenance toward active, KPI-based management of the traffic signal network.

**What Required Skills You’ll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Transportation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a closely related field.
* 15+ years of specialized, progressive experience in traffic signal systems planning, design, implementation, operations, optimization, and performance management for transportation agencies or major transport owners/operators.
* Advanced knowledge of adaptive signal systems, including adaptive control principles, detector dependency, progression logic, queue management, real-time response, system calibration, and performance evaluation.
* Demonstrated experience working with multiple signal control platforms, central traffic signal systems, controller environments, and field device ecosystems, with the ability to compare platform strengths, limitations, and integration requirements.
* Strong hands-on experience with signal timing and operations, including actuated control, coordinated control, time-of-day plans, traffic-responsive plans, pedestrian timing, phase sequencing, recalls, detector assignments, and controller parameter settings.
* Demonstrated ability to diagnose and resolve traffic signal operational problems using field observations, controller logs, detector data, traffic counts, travel time data, video review, ATSPM dashboards, and before/after performance measures.
* Strong understanding of traffic signal controllers, cabinets, detection technologies, communications networks, central systems, firmware/configuration issues, fail-safe behavior, and field troubleshooting practices.
* Experience developing, reviewing, or implementing traffic signal standards, controller specifications, signal design criteria, programming guidelines, testing procedures, and operational SOPs.
* Working knowledge of ITS and ATMS integration principles, including interfaces between traffic signal systems and central platforms, detection systems, CCTV/video analytics, AVL/public transport systems, traveler information systems, and incident management tools.
* Experience supporting public transport signal priority, emergency vehicle preemption, pedestrian detection and timing, freight corridor signal coordination, and major event or construction traffic signal operations.
* Ability to lead technical reviews of contractor/vendor submissions, design packages, test plans, commissioning records, and operational readiness documentation.
* Excellent facilitation and stakeholder engagement skills, with experience leading technical workshops and resolving differing viewpoints across agencies, consultants, contractors, operators, and technology vendors.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to produce clear technical narratives, signal operations guidance, review comments, process flows, diagrams, and executive-level summaries.

* Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, multi-project environment, managing competing technical priorities while maintaining quality, safety, and operational consistency.

**What Desired Skills You’ll Bring:**

* Prior experience supporting Gulf region transportation agencies or large metropolitan transport authorities on traffic signal systems, adaptive signal operations, TCC operations, or ITS/ATMS programs.
* Familiarity with international traffic signal and ITS best practices, standards, and guidance, including MUTCD-style signal principles, NTCIP concepts, ATC/controller environments, AASHTO/ITE guidance, and locally adopted agency standards.
* Practical experience with major adaptive or central signal platforms such as SCOOT, SCATS, TransSuite, KLD, Siemens/Yunex, Econolite, or comparable systems is highly desirable.
* Experience with ATSPM implementation, high-resolution event data, signal performance dashboards, data quality management, and automated alerts for signal failures or operational anomalies.
* Experience integrating traffic signal systems with AI/video analytics, connected vehicle data, probe data, AVL data, enforcement systems, ramp metering, or decision support systems.
* Experience developing or supporting traffic signal operations programs for large cities with 500+ signalized intersections, complex arterial corridors, public transport integration, and major-event operating demands.
* Experience with capacity building, technical mentoring, change management, and training related to traffic signal systems and TCC operations.
* Professional registration/certification such as PE, CEng, PTOE, RSP, PMP, or similar is an advantage.

* Arabic language skills are desirable but not required.

**Security Clearance Requirement:**

None

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Materials Engineer (Architectural/Structural)** to join our team!

The Materials Engineer will be responsible for managing and providing technical oversight of all construction materials engineering, testing, approval, inspection, and compliance activities across the project. The role will ensure that materials proposed and used by contractors comply with approved project specifications, applicable standards, design requirements, and client requirements.

The Materials Engineer position will coordinate closely with Materials Engineering, Quality, Construction, Procurement Engineering, Testing Laboratories, Independent Inspection Agencies, Consultants, Contractors, and Materials Suppliers, Manufacturers, Cement Concrete Batching Plants and Asphalt Plants to ensure the timely review, approval, inspection, testing, storage, handling, and traceability of construction materials throughout the project lifecycle.

The Materials Engineer dedicated to overseeing and managing all material-related workflows and compliance processes. To ensure seamless coordination between within Materials Management Team and all departments.

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Strategic Procurement Review and Tracking: Approved Materials List (AML), Project Approved Materials List (PAML), and Long Lead Items (LLI) tracking.
    
* Materials Governance (MQG) Submittals & Planning: Materials Management Plans (MMPs)/Procurement Quality Plans (PQPs), Inspection Assignment Package (IAP), Pre-Inspection Meetings (PIM), Supplier/Manufacturer ITPs, Third Part Inspector CVs, Contractor's Materials Team CVs and PQCS CVs Reviews.
    
* Vendors, Third Party Testing & Inspection Agencies, Materials Technical Approvals: Prequalification Submittals (PQDs), Material Technical Submittals (MATs), FAT Witnessing Plans, Factory Acceptance Testing Procedures (FATPs).
    
* Physical Evaluations & Field Verification: Samples (SMPs), Mockups, Laboratory Mix Design (JMF) Trials, Concrete Plant Trials Witness Activities, Asphalt (HMA) Plant Trials Witness Activities.
    
* Inspections & Testing: Material Inspection Requests (MIRs), and Third-Party/Specialized Testing Laboratories and Independent Inspection Agencies Assessments.
    

**What Required Skills You'll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Architectural/Structural Engineering, Materials Engineering, Construction Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 8+ years of relevant experience in construction materials engineering, materials testing, quality control, or project quality management.
* Proven experience in major airport, infrastructure, civil, roads, utilities, or large-scale construction projects.
* Strong knowledge of construction materials, testing methodologies, specifications, and material approval processes.
* Experience working with contractors, consultants, suppliers, and accredited testing laboratories.
* Good understanding of material quality requirements and construction specifications.
* Professional Engineering certification is preferred.
* ACI, NICET, ASQ, or equivalent materials/testing certification is an advantage.
* Relevant laboratory or materials testing certifications are preferred.
* ISO 9001 / Quality Management certification is an advantage.
* Relevant pavement, concrete, asphalt, or geotechnical materials certifications are advantageous.
* Construction Materials Engineering
* Material Submittal & Approval
* Material Testing & Inspection
* Material Compliance & Verification
* Material Traceability
* Material Testing Plans
* Material Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs)
* Concrete & Cementitious Materials
* Aggregates & Soils
* Asphalt & Pavement Materials
* Reinforcement & Structural Steel
* Pipes & Utility Materials
* Geotextiles & Geosynthetics
* Geotechnical Materials
* Laboratory Testing & Test Results Review
* Mix Design Review
* Concrete Testing
* Asphalt Testing
* Soil & Compaction Testing
* CBR & Field Density Testing
* NCR & Corrective Action Management
* Material Quality Auditing
* Supplier & Manufacturer Evaluation
* Factory / Source Inspection
* Material Storage & Preservation
* Technical Submittal Review
* ASTM / AASHTO / BS / EN / ISO Standards
* Material Documentation & Handover Dossiers
* MS Excel & Technical Reporting

**What Desired Skills You'll Bring:**

* Aviation-Specific Standards (Interpret and enforce ICAO, FAA, EASA, and local civil aviation authority specifications across all civil/structural pavement materials)
    
* Design Development Review (Critically review technical specifications, design drawings, and material submittals during early design and pre-construction stages)
    
* Regulatory Compliance (Liaise with regulatory bodies and AHJs to secure material approvals and confirm adherence to national infrastructure codes)
    
* Quality & Statistical Process Control (Implement SPC techniques to monitor batching plant outputs, asphalt mix consistency, and site testing results, ensuring zero defect tolerance)
    
* Specialized Materials Testing (Define test protocols and review lab/field results for pavement skid resistance, Marshall/Superpave mix design, concrete fatigue, durability and Performance testing)
    
* Procurement Engineering (Perform technical audits of material suppliers, review TDS, mill test certificates (MTCs), and support technical assessment during procurement stage).

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Senior Project Quality Specialist** **(Saudi National)** to join our Team!

The Senior Project Quality Specialist will support the implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of the Project Quality Management System across the Airport / Infrastructure / Airfield project. The role will provide specialist quality support to Engineering, Construction, Procurement, Commissioning, and Project Management teams, ensuring that project activities and deliverables comply with approved quality requirements, contractual obligations, specifications, standards, and Client expectations.

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Support the implementation and maintenance of the Project Quality Management System (QMS).
    
* Monitor compliance with the Project Quality Plan, quality procedures, specifications, standards, and contractual requirements.
    
* Provide specialist quality support to Engineering, Construction, Procurement, Commissioning, and Project Management teams.
    
* Review project quality procedures, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), Method Statements, checklists, and quality-related documentation.
    
* Ensure quality requirements are clearly defined and incorporated into project execution plans and work packages.
    
* Conduct quality surveillance and compliance inspections across project activities.
    
* Monitor implementation of approved quality procedures by contractors, subcontractors, consultants, and suppliers.
    
* Review and verify inspection and testing requirements for project works.
    
* Monitor quality records, inspection reports, test results, material approvals, and other quality documentation.
    
* Identify quality risks, trends, recurring deficiencies, and potential non-conformances.
    
* Support the development and implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
    
* Review Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), observations, deficiencies, and quality concerns and monitor their timely closure.
    
* Perform root cause analysis for significant or recurring quality issues.
    
* Support the implementation of corrective and preventive action plans.
    
* Conduct internal quality audits and support external and Client audits.
    
* Prepare audit plans, audit reports, findings, observations, and follow-up actions.
    
* Monitor closure of audit findings and verify effectiveness of corrective actions.
    
* Review contractor and subcontractor Quality Management Systems and quality plans.
    
* Participate in prequalification and quality capability assessments of contractors, suppliers, and subcontractors.
    
* Review quality-related technical submissions, procedures, and project documentation.
    
* Coordinate with Document Control to ensure quality records are properly controlled, traceable, and maintained.
    
* Monitor quality performance indicators and prepare quality reports and dashboards.
    
* Analyze project quality data to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
    
* Provide regular quality performance updates to the Project Quality Manager and Project Management.
    
* Support quality awareness, training, workshops, and toolbox sessions.
    
* Promote a proactive quality culture across the project.
    
* Support investigation of quality incidents, failures, and major deficiencies.
    
* Participate in technical and quality review meetings with Client, Consultant, Contractors, and project stakeholders.
    
* Ensure lessons learned are captured and incorporated into project quality processes.
    
* Support project handover and closeout by ensuring quality dossiers and records are complete and compliant.
    

**Engineering & Design Quality Responsibilities**

* Review engineering deliverables for compliance with approved quality requirements and project procedures.
    
* Monitor implementation of design quality control and checking processes.
    
* Support audits of Lead Design Consultants and specialist design consultants.
    
* Monitor design review, checking, verification, and approval processes.
    
* Track design-related quality comments, observations, and corrective actions.
    
* Verify that design changes are appropriately reviewed, documented, and controlled.
    
* Support multidisciplinary design quality reviews and technical audits.
    
* Monitor compliance of engineering deliverables with applicable codes, standards, Client requirements, and approved design criteria.
    
* Support resolution of recurring design quality issues and identify opportunities for process improvement.
    

**Construction Quality Responsibilities**

* Monitor implementation of construction quality requirements across site activities.
    
* Conduct surveillance inspections of critical construction activities.
    
* Review ITPs, Method Statements, WIRs, MIRs, testing records, and quality documentation.
    
* Verify that required inspections and tests are completed before subsequent construction activities proceed.
    
* Monitor material quality, testing, traceability, storage, and compliance.
    
* Support investigation of construction defects and recurring quality issues.
    
* Monitor NCR trends and contractor performance.
    
* Coordinate with Construction and QA/QC teams to ensure timely resolution of quality issues.
    
* **Airport / Infrastructure & Airfield Responsibilities**
    
* Support quality management across airport terminals, airfield infrastructure, runways, taxiways, aprons, roads, utilities, district cooling, and associated infrastructure works.
    
* Monitor quality requirements associated with critical airport and airfield systems.
    
* Support audits and surveillance activities for specialist aviation and infrastructure works.
    
* Ensure quality requirements for airside and landside works are appropriately implemented.
    
* Support quality assurance during phased construction and complex interface activities.
    
* Monitor compliance with project-specific airport, aviation, infrastructure, and authority requirements.
    

**Quality Performance & Reporting**

* Develop and maintain quality performance dashboards and reports.
    
* Monitor key quality indicators, including:
    
* NCRs
    
* Observations
    
* Audit Findings
    
* First-Time Pass Rate
    
* Inspection Performance
    
* Test Failures
    
* Rework
    
* Corrective Action Closure
    
* Quality Trends
    
* Identify areas of poor quality performance and recommend improvement initiatives.
    
* Provide data-driven recommendations to Project Quality Management and senior leadership.
    
* Prepare weekly and monthly quality reports.
    
* Support management reviews and quality performance presentations.
    

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
    
* Minimum of **10 years of relevant experience** in project quality management, QA/QC, quality assurance, or quality control.
    
* Strong experience on major construction, infrastructure, airport, or multidisciplinary projects.
    
* Proven experience implementing and monitoring Project Quality Management Systems.
    
* Strong experience with audits, inspections, NCR management, corrective actions, and quality performance monitoring.
    
* Experience working with Clients, Consultants, Contractors, and specialist subcontractors.
    
* Strong knowledge of ISO 9001 and quality management principles.
    
* Experience with engineering and construction quality processes is highly desirable.
    
* Strong knowledge of quality documentation, ITPs, Method Statements, inspection procedures, and testing requirements.
    
* Experience on airport / airfield projects is preferred.
    
* ISO 9001 Lead Auditor or equivalent quality certification is preferred.

description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

  
  

**About The Role:**  
The Senior Consultant will lead a team dedicated to performing Red Team activities simulating known threat actor, to help CrowdStrike customers determine the impact and likelihood of threat actor to accomplish objective across the Kill Chain and MITRE ATT&CK Framework. The Senior Red Team Consultant is expected to be able to coordinate with senior leadership, plan, and oversee execution of assessments and assist the other CrowdStrike Services’ functions to help improve customers security defense. This person should be capable of supporting, managing, and mentoring less experienced red team members.  
  
**What You'll Do:**

* Act as a primary contact for coordination of Red Team activities as well as coordinating and leading all penetration testing activities.
    
* Develop reporting including mitigations strategies of results of Red Team activities for both management and technical audiences.
    
* Must be able to effectively communicate at all levels (executive leadership and technical support teams) within CrowdStrike.

**Job Title:** EPMS Engineer  


**Job Purpose**

The EPMS Engineer is responsible for driving the resolution and closeout of all outstanding EPMS-related technical, functional, integration, testing, and commissioning issues. The role involves coordinating with engineering contractors, vendors, commissioning teams, operations personnel, and project stakeholders to ensure the EPMS is fully functional, compliant with project requirements, and ready for final handover.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Issue Management and Closeout**

* Review, prioritize, and manage all EPMS punch list items and outstanding actions.
    
* Maintain a comprehensive EPMS issue tracker with owners, target dates, and status updates.
    
* Investigate technical issues, determine root causes, and coordinate corrective actions.
    
* Verify that all identified issues are resolved and formally closed.
    

**Technical Support**

* Provide technical expertise on EPMS architecture, hardware, software, networking, and system integration.
    
* Review configuration settings, alarms, events, reports, dashboards, and monitoring functions.
    
* Support troubleshooting of communication issues between EPMS, SCADA, DCS, PLCs, protection relays, meters, and other integrated systems.
    
* Validate system performance against project specifications and operational requirements.
    

**Testing and Verification**

* Develop and execute test procedures for issue verification and closeout.
    
* Witness and document retesting activities following corrective actions.
    
* Ensure all functional, integration, and reliability tests are successfully completed.
    
* Support SAT, commissioning, and performance testing activities.
    

**Vendor and Contractor Coordination**

* Interface with EPMS suppliers, system integrators, OEMs, and EPC contractors.
    
* Monitor vendor action items and ensure timely resolution of defects.
    
* Review and approve technical submissions, software revisions, and configuration changes.
    
* Facilitate technical meetings to drive issue resolution.
    

**Documentation and Handover**

* Ensure all as-built documentation is complete and accurate.
    
* Review operating procedures, maintenance manuals, and user guides.
    
* Verify closure of all comments from FAT, SAT, commissioning, and operational readiness reviews.
    
* Support final handover to operations and maintenance teams.
    

**Reporting**

* Provide regular status reports on outstanding issues, risks, and mitigation plans.
    
* Highlight critical path items affecting project completion.
    
* Escalate unresolved technical issues to project management when required.
    

**Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or a related discipline.
    

**Experience**

* 5–10+ years of experience in electrical power systems, SCADA, EMS, or EPMS projects.
    
* Experience with commissioning and troubleshooting electrical monitoring and control systems.
    
* Proven track record in managing punch lists and closeout activities during project execution.
    

**Technical Skills**

* Knowledge of power system monitoring, protection, and control systems.
    
* Familiarity with communication protocols such as Modbus, IEC 61850, DNP3, OPC, and Ethernet networks.
    
* Experience with electrical substations, switchgear, protection relays, energy meters, and power management systems.
    
* Understanding of FAT, SAT, commissioning, and handover processes.
    
* Ability to analyze system logs, alarms, events, and performance data.
    

**Soft Skills**

* Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.
    
* Excellent coordination and stakeholder management skills.
    
* Strong written and verbal communication.
    
* Ability to manage multiple issues and priorities in a fast-paced project environment.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented Material Engineer to join our team!

## **What You’ll Be Doing**

* Review project specifications, drawings, material requirements, and applicable standards to establish material compliance requirements.
    
* Review and evaluate Material Submittals, Material Approval Requests (MARs), Technical Submittals, and related documentation.
    
* Verify that proposed materials comply with project specifications, approved design, international standards, and Client requirements.
    
* Coordinate with Engineering and QA/QC teams regarding material specifications, technical requirements, and approval status.
    
* Review manufacturers' data sheets, technical literature, certificates of conformity, test certificates, and other supporting documentation.
    
* Coordinate material inspections, sampling, testing, and laboratory activities in accordance with approved Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs).
    
* Monitor material testing requirements and ensure testing is conducted by approved laboratories.
    
* Review material test results and confirm compliance with specified acceptance criteria.
    
* Inspect materials upon delivery to verify quantity, condition, identification, certification, and compliance with approved submittals.
    
* Monitor material storage, handling, preservation, and protection requirements, particularly for materials sensitive to environmental conditions.
    
* Maintain and update material registers, approval logs, testing records, and material tracking systems.
    
* Coordinate with Procurement and Construction teams to ensure approved materials are available in accordance with the project schedule.
    
* Identify material-related risks that may affect construction progress, quality, cost, or schedule.
    
* Support the resolution of material-related Technical Queries (TQs), Requests for Information (RFIs), Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), and site issues.
    
* Review proposed alternative materials and substitutions and provide technical recommendations for approval.
    
* Ensure traceability of materials from procurement and delivery through installation and final acceptance.
    
* Coordinate with suppliers and manufacturers regarding technical compliance, testing, warranties, and material documentation.
    
* Support audits and inspections conducted by the Client, Consultant, and relevant authorities.
    
* Ensure material documentation is properly maintained and available for project handover and closeout.
    
* Provide technical support to construction teams regarding material selection, application, installation, and compliance requirements.
    
* Monitor material quality trends and identify recurring issues requiring corrective or preventive action.
    
* Ensure compliance with project HSE requirements during material inspection, testing, handling, and storage activities.
    
* Participate in technical meetings, material coordination meetings, and quality review meetings.
    
* Prepare material status reports and provide input to project quality and progress reporting.
    

## Airport / Infrastructure Specific Responsibilities

* Review materials associated with airfield works, including pavement materials, aggregates, concrete, asphalt, geosynthetics, drainage materials, utilities, roadworks, and associated infrastructure systems.
    
* Ensure materials used for runway, taxiway, apron, roads, utilities, and external works comply with project and aviation requirements.
    
* Coordinate testing and acceptance of aggregates, asphalt, concrete, soil, sub-base, base-course, and other civil construction materials.
    
* Review material requirements for airfield pavement systems and associated infrastructure works.
    
* Coordinate with specialist testing laboratories for field and laboratory testing activities.
    
* Support verification of material compliance with applicable ASTM, AASHTO, BS/EN, FAA, ICAO, and project-specific requirements, as applicable.
    
* Ensure appropriate material traceability and quality records are maintained for critical airfield and infrastructure works.
    

## **What Required Skills You’ll Bring**

* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Materials Engineering, Construction Engineering, or a related discipline.
    
* Minimum **8 years of relevant experience** in construction materials engineering, material inspection, testing, and quality control.
    
* Experience in major infrastructure, airport, airfield, roads, utilities, or large-scale construction projects is preferred.
    
* Strong knowledge of construction materials, laboratory testing, material specifications, and quality control procedures.
    
* Experience with Material Submittals, MARs, ITPs, MIRs, NCRs, RFIs, and technical documentation.
    
* Familiarity with ASTM, AASHTO, BS/EN and other relevant international standards.
    
* Experience coordinating with material suppliers, manufacturers, testing laboratories, contractors, consultants, and Clients.
    
* Strong understanding of material approval, inspection, testing, storage, handling, and traceability processes.
    
* Previous experience on airport or airfield projects will be highly advantageous.
    

## **What Desired Skills You’ll Bring**

* Material Engineering & Testing
    
* Construction Quality Control
    
* Material Submittal & Approval
    
* Specification Compliance
    
* Laboratory & Field Testing
    
* Material Inspection
    
* Technical Documentation
    
* Quality Assurance
    
* Problem Solving
    
* Stakeholder Coordination
    
* Risk Identification
    
* Attention to Detail
    
* Communication & Reporting
    
* Teamwork and Collaboration

description:
### Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **Application Operations Engineer** to support the stability, availability, performance, and continuous improvement of enterprise applications. The role covers application operations across incident, problem, change, release, backup/recovery, disaster recovery, and service improvement activities.

### Key Responsibilities

* Manage **L2/L3 functional incidents**, including participation in incident bridges and escalation management.
* Perform **incident and problem management**, including incident trend analysis and implementation of permanent fixes.
* Develop and manage **Service Improvement Plans**.
* Support **release schedule and planning** activities.
* Plan and coordinate **Change Requests (CRs)**, including risk and impact assessments.
* Perform **application-layer change implementation** and conduct post-implementation reviews.
* Handle application configuration requests.
* Monitor application **performance and availability**.
* Perform **event correlation** and investigate application-related events.
* Manage application **capacity and performance**.
* Develop and test **application recovery procedures**.
* Configure application backups and execute **application and data restores**.
* Participate in and execute **Disaster Recovery (DR) tests**.
* Perform **OS, database, and middleware hardening** activities.
* Apply patches and updates to application components.
* Maintain accurate **CMDB records** for application components.
* Collaborate with relevant technical teams to ensure application stability and service availability.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in **Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field**.
* Relevant experience in **Application Operations / Application Support** in an enterprise environment.
* Strong hands-on experience with **L2/L3 application incident and problem management**.
* Experience with **change management, release planning, and application-layer change implementation**.
* Experience conducting **risk and impact assessments** for application changes.
* Hands-on experience with **application performance and availability monitoring** and event correlation.
* Experience with **application backup, restore, and recovery procedures**.
* Experience participating in or executing **Disaster Recovery (DR) tests**.
* Good understanding of **OS, database, and middleware hardening and patching**.
* Experience with **capacity and performance management**.
* Experience maintaining **CMDB application component records**.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, escalation management, and communication skills.
* Ability to work with multiple technical teams during **major incidents and incident bridges**.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is seeking a highly specialized and experienced **GIS Manager - Saudi National** to join our critical team on the prestigious Qiddiya Project in Riyadh.

The GIS Manager leads complex production planning and delivery of geographic information system (GIS) services for large programs and projects. This role oversees sector‑wide GIS production, staffing coordination and technical guidance, using GIS principles, techniques and analyses to drive team productivity and ensure high‑quality geospatial deliverables.

The GIS Manager functions as the primary technical authority on GIS matters, defining data models, workflows and standards, and ensuring that spatial data is accurate, validated and fit for reliable analysis and decision‑making.  


## What you'll be doing:

* Oversee management of sector‑wide GIS initiatives, GIS production, functionalities, troubleshooting, practices and procedures.
* Provide expert guidance and assume responsibility for the quality of GIS deliverables developed for the program/project.
* Perform in a lead capacity for geospatial model delivery, management and integration with other digital models.
* Determine methods and solutions for complex GIS mapping challenges and select the most efficient plan for implementation.
* Participate in budget and cost forecasting analysis in support of the management team.
* Support preparation of competitive technical and commercial proposals, including GIS scope, approach and resource estimates.
* Communicate project objectives, plans and status to the project team and management, ensuring alignment on GIS activities and deliverables.
* Assist in developing initial level‑of‑effort estimates required to cover all GIS work within the proposed scope, with minimal supervision.
* Continuously monitor, evaluate and improve GIS delivery, identifying opportunities for automation, optimization and innovation.
* Provide leadership in defining data types, relationships, constraints and indexes to enable efficient querying and spatial analysis.
* Monitor team assignments and productivity; support management in organizing staffing/resource assignments for GIS tasks.
* Train and develop team members, including:
* Developing training plans and supervising training needs assessments
* Creating detailed training manuals and GIS tutorial videos
* Providing advanced technical support and coaching in the use of GIS systems, software and databases
* Manage spatial accuracy of data representations to ensure reliable spatial analysis.
* Advance and confirm data completeness and validation for robust spatial analysis and decision‑making.
* Serve as subject matter expert and primary contact for client(s) and agencies on all technical GIS matters.
* Generate detailed reports on GIS delivery, including key performance indicators (KPIs) and progress metrics.
* Oversee development of model builders and customized tools to streamline geospatial tasks and workflows.
* Oversee implementation and optimization of database design and administration processes for spatial data.
* Manage databases to maintain accuracy, consistency and integrity of geospatial data.
* Oversee management and tracking of task assignments, data management activities, preparation of data model structures and data transformation processes.
* Oversee definition and enforcement of topology rules to maintain data integrity and spatial accuracy.
* Maintain a risk‑averse approach while reviewing geospatial outputs and proposing mitigation solutions for identified risks.
* Collaborate with project teams for effective integration of GIS models with engineering, BIM and other digital models.
* Perform in an advisory capacity to senior management on GIS‑related work matters, including strategy, technology adoption and resourcing.
* Perform other responsibilities associated with this position as may be appropriate.

**What required skills you'll bring:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in GIS, Geography, Geomatics, Engineering, Computer Science or related discipline (or equivalent work experience).
* 10 years of related work experience in GIS, spatial data management or geospatial analysis, including significant experience on large programs/projects.
* Expert knowledge of commonly used core GIS, Computer‑Aided Design (CAD) and Building Information Management (BIM) software/database packages and workflows.
* Expert knowledge of complex GIS production for large programs and projects, including multi‑site and multi‑disciplinary environments.
* Ability to apply concepts to assignments including:
* Developing and managing workflows and processes
* Troubleshooting and providing innovative solutions
* Conducting capacity and capability assessments for GIS task teams
* Staying current with emerging GIS technologies and setting GIS priorities
* Advanced skill in programming and scripting languages for GIS and automation tasks (e.g. Python, JavaScript).
* Ability to perform in a managerial capacity for database delivery, with effective leadership and organizational skills.
* Effective leadership skills; capable of directing, guiding and supervising production staff in geospatial work.
* Proficiency in building information modelling software and understanding of GIS–BIM data integration principles.
* Ability to lead and direct staff on GIS systems, software/technologies, database use and best practices.
* Ability to generate detailed reports on GIS delivery for projects/programs, including KPI reporting and tracking.
* Expert proficiency in various hardware and software used in GIS, CAD and BIM, and ability to manage hardware and software deployments in coordination with IT and responsible parties.
* Ability to confirm that security settings and dedicated server sites for GIS data are effectively managed.
* Expert understanding of Quality Assurance / Quality Control (QA/QC) standard practices and procedures; capable of guiding staff on quality implementation.
* Strong understanding of desktop, web and mobile GIS applications, and associated workbenches/tools.
* Ability to stay engaged with current technology and industry trends as they apply to GIS practices and standards.
* Ability to communicate modelling, survey and GIS technical and non‑technical subjects clearly with management, engineering and production staff.

We are seeking an SAP-EAMS Director to join JASARA PMC. This role will lead enterprise asset management systems, SAP EAMS readiness and asset data governance, working across City Operations, City AM, Asset Class BUs and O&M teams to create a trusted single source of asset information.

The Enterprise Asset Management Director is accountable for leading the city’s enterprise asset management systems, asset information governance and SAP EAMS preparation within the City Asset Management organisation. The role works closely with City Operations, the wider AM team, Asset Class BUs, O&M teams, handover, digital, finance and governance functions to ensure asset information, operational requirements and AM standards are aligned across the city operating model from an AM point of view.

The position acts as the business owner for SAP EAMS design decisions, data migration standards, process integration and reporting requirements, ensuring the platform enables reliable operations, lifecycle planning, maintenance delivery, service-quality monitoring and investment decision-making. It embeds the AM data model, workflows, KPIs and reporting framework so City Operations, portfolios and O&M teams have one trusted source of asset information and a consistent approach to asset performance, lifecycle and renewals planning.

**Key Responsibilities**

### 1\. Enterprise AM Systems Strategy and Governance

· Define and maintain the enterprise asset management systems strategy, roadmap, governance framework and operating model for City AM and City Operations.

· Act as business owner for SAP EAMS design decisions, ensuring system configuration reflects approved AM policies, lifecycle processes, service-quality standards, operational requirements and governance controls.

· Align AM systems, asset data standards and reporting outputs with portfolio priorities, asset intersections and operational requirements that support integrated city planning.

· Establish clear decision rights, escalation routes and accountabilities across City AM, City Operations, O&M, Asset Class BUs, Digital, Finance, Procurement, Handover and governance teams.

· Lead standards for asset information ownership, configuration control, system access, master data stewardship and change control.

· Provide executive advice, options, risks, cost implications and recommendations on enterprise AM systems, data quality, SAP EAMS readiness and city-wide AM integration.

### 2\. SAP EAMS Preparation, Cut-over and Integration

Management, Finance, districts, operators and delivery teams to ensure operational costs, common area services and shared infrastructure are appropriately understood, allocated and recoverable where applicable.The role acts as the owner and custodian of the city-wide service charge model, providing governance, oversight and assurance over cost allocation methodologies, cost recovery structures and service charge assumptions. The position also leads the identification and evaluation of revenue opportunities across city assets, facilities, infrastructure and common areas, ensuring opportunities are assessed from operational, commercial and asset-management perspectives before recommendations are escalated to senior management. The role directs the Service Charges & Revenue Senior Manager and works closely with Lifecycle Planning, Finance, Asset Management, City Operations and district stakeholders to support long-term operational sustainability, financial resilience and value optimization across the city operating model.

operating principles across applicable assets, facilities, services and districts.

governance requirements.

commercial objectives.

review and approval.

responsibilities and district requirements.

decision making.

reflected within service charge calculations.

maturity.

• Develop management information, dashboards and reporting outputs to support leadership review and decision making.

**3\. Revenue Strategy and Commercial Opportunity Assessment**

facilities, services and common areas.

managed assets.

long-term city objectives.

enhancement.

**4\. OPEX and Lifecycle Cost Integration**

delivery models.

and long-term asset funding requirements into service charge considerations.

assessments.

assumptions.

• Support integrated planning through clear visibility of operational expenditure, lifecycle obligations and recovery

opportunities.

• Promote alignment between operational sustainability objectives and cost recovery strategies.

**5\. Financial Assurance and Cost Recovery Performance**

cost allocation structures.

leakage.

• Coordinate assurance activities relating to service charge calculations, allocation methodologies and recovery

assumptions.

• Provide recommendations to improve transparency, accountability and effectiveness of cost recovery arrangements.

• Support leadership reporting on cost recovery performance, service charge outcomes and operational affordability

pressures.

• Monitor trends, exceptions and performance indicators to identify emerging risks and improvement opportunities.

• Ensure service charge arrangements remain sustainable and support long-term operational and financial objectives.

• Develop governance reporting and performance dashboards covering cost recovery effectiveness and financial resilience.

**6\. District, Operator and Stakeholder Interface**

stakeholders.

initiatives.

Facilitate discussions on operating assumptions, service levels, allocation methodologies, charging structures and

recovery mechanisms.

governance arrangements.

• Support resolution of service charge and cost allocation issues through structured engagement, analysis and

recommendations.

• Promote transparency and understanding of charging methodologies and governance requirements across stakeholders.

• Facilitate cross-functional reviews of emerging operational, commercial and cost recovery challenges.

outputs.

assessment processes.

arrangements and revenue opportunities against relevant market comparators.
