The SAP Academy for Customer Success is a global development program designed for talent who are early in their career.
Who You’ll become
A Solution Advisor works closely with our customers and prospects to identify and solve business challenges and meet their strategic objectives using SAP solutions. As part of the sales team, a Solution Advisor is the “subject matter expert” responsible for the functional and technical knowledge within the sales cycle. A Solution Advisor provides deal support by participating in discovery sessions, executive meetings and presentations and delivers software demonstrations that help the customer understand SAP’s unique value proposition. In addition to deal support, the Solution Advisor participates in marketing events to generate demand, leads Design Thinking sessions, and collaborates with the broader sales team to identify whitespace opportunities at existing accounts.
What You’ll Do
As a Solution Advisor within the SAP Next Gen - Academy for Customer Success, you will be responsible to:
+ Successfully complete a 10-month program that strengthens the foundation for a successful customer-facing career at SAP.
+ Participate in experiential learning opportunities with colleagues from all over the world and acquire a wide variety of business, industry and SAP solution skills while working with emerging and cutting-edge technologies.
+ Receive on-the-job training under the mentorship of a senior Solution Advisor colleague while working with our customers to gain real world experience and acquire the skills necessary to help guide our customers through their Digital Transformation journey.
The program will enrich your knowledge of SAP and give you the professional experience to serve our customers. We offer full-time employment from day one with practical learning applications for your role. After successful completion of the program, you are expected to lead customer discovery sessions and survey activities to uncover business challenges and opportunities for innovation. You will create and deliver high impact and engaging software demonstrations that compel the customers to select SAP over other competitive offerings. You will also provide demand generation support through marketing events and deal execution support by responding to request for proposals.
What You Bring
+ 2-3 years of professional experience with a strong foundation in technical and business processes, exposure to relevant technologies/solutions, and customer-facing skills.
+ Technical and business process knowledge, combined with hands-on experience using relevant technologies and industry-standard tools to support solution delivery and operational efficiency.
+ A cooperative and productive approach to working relationships, internally and externally.
+ A strong ability to quickly learn new concepts, adapt to changing environments, and apply knowledge to deliver results.
+ An understanding of AI fundamentals, uses, and ethics, to identify business problems solvable with AI.
+ Strong Business Acumen, including demonstrated knowledge of business processes and/or industries.
+ Proficiency in English and Italian to engage with our global and local network.
+ AI focus areas: (AI Adoption Mindset, Agentic AI Day-to Day Practice, and Context Engineering)
+ A curious and agile mindset, with a passion for learning and the resilience to adapt in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
+ Strong problem-solving, project management, and creative thinking skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and communicate ideas clearly and effectively.
+ Emotional intelligence and cultural awareness that support inclusive teamwork and thoughtful stakeholder engagement.
+ A growing foundation in business acumen and emerging technologies, especially artificial intelligence, paired with a results-oriented approach and the courage to take initiative.
About SAP Academy for Customer Success
The SAP Academy for Customer Success offers a three-year journey that drives accountability and enhances productivity. It enables graduates to make a quick impact in customer-facing roles while fostering career longevity and leadership potential.
Join us for a unique opportunity to build a global network, collaborate with customers to solve real business challenges, and gain hands-on experience with world-class cloud solutions — all while learning in a dynamic environment and earning competitive pay and benefits.
#SAPAcademyforCustomerSuccess
#SAPNextGen
SAP Next Gen is our global experience for students and early talent (0–3 years of professional work experience). Being a part of the Next Gen community provides access to a supportive global network, tailored development opportunities, and the ability to contribute to high-impact projects across the business.
SAP’s employees across different regions are enabled to do their best job with the right mix of office and remote work according to country-specific guidelines and regulations. In general, our hybrid work setup consists of three days a week in the office or on-site with customers or partners.
We are planning a practical and immersive portion of our program, which will likely involve participants spending four (4) weeks, spread across two trips, in San Ramon, California. This experience is designed to provide unparalleled hands-on learning and networking opportunities.
During intensive phases of the program, it is critical that all participants are fully engaged and present to ensure maximum learning and success. As such, vacation will not be approved during some critical times of the program.
Bring out your best
SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.
We win with inclusion
SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. job_title: Sales Manager Cityscape West - Freelance/Contingent role
description:
## Company Description

Tahaluf is the largest B2B live and on-demand events organiser in Saudi Arabia by space, attendance, colleagues, and revenue. It is a joint venture between Informa PLC, the Saudi Federation for Cybersecurity, Programming and Drones (SAFCSP), and the Events Investment Fund (EIF).  
  
Tahaluf is bold, visionary, and determined to make an impact. Our team fosters a culture of collaboration, creativity, and a little fun, here teamwork rules and work feels as exciting as the events we create. Scaling at this pace also requires exceptional local partners, and Tahaluf is proud to work with a range of government and non-government organisations at the forefront of Saudi Arabia’s B2B and B2C large-scale events scene.  
  
Be part of something BIG with Tahaluf’s series of record-breaking events: LEAP and Cityscape - the largest events in the world in their respective fields of tech and real estate; Black Hat MEA - a Guinness World Record holder for the largest CTF competition during the event; and CPHI Middle East - the largest pharma debut event in history, to name just a few. Tahaluf is making a huge impact on the global events sector.  
  
Join our ambitious and highly committed team, unafraid to push boundaries and disrupt the status quo. From day one, you’ll dive into large-scale projects under the guidance of a supportive leadership team that will encourage your personal development and open doors to new opportunities.

## Job Description

In this Sales Manager role you will oversee assigned territories and contribute to the achievement and exceeding of sales revenue targets for the team in accordance with the sales plan.

You will work closely with local and international clients, particularly in the real estate sector, and will play a key role in driving sales for Cityscape events.

**Key Focus Areas:**

* Achievement of sales revenue targets, campaign management, and floor plan management within timelines.
* Meeting KPIs set by the portfolio, including phone time, face-to-face meetings, and CRM system usage.
* Ensuring exhibitor satisfaction through regular follow-ups, onsite rebookings, and retention strategies.
* Timely and accurate reporting of sales results, pipeline, and activities.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders and clients, particularly in the real estate sector.
* Support business development efforts and identify new sales opportunities, including innovative hunting techniques.
* Execute sales strategies for both established events and new launches.
* Assist with project timelines and deliverables for event launches.
* Collaborate with marketing, operations, and content teams to ensure seamless execution of events.
* Track sales pipeline and work toward achieving targets, including organic sales growth.
* Represent Tahaluf at trade shows and industry events, showcasing confidence and professionalism.
* Support team members in their sales activities and contribute to the team’s restructuring efforts.

**Measures of Success:**

* Achievement of revenue targets and pipeline pacing.
* Number of proposals submitted per week and pipeline closure rates.
* Effectiveness in research and lead generation.
* Campaign planning and management results.
* Business development outcomes, including new client acquisition and retention.
* Exhibitor satisfaction levels and onsite rebooking rates.

## Qualifications

**Qualifications**

**Essential**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
* Proven B2B and/or events sales experience, preferably with GCC exposure.
* Strong understanding of the real estate industry and key account management.
* Excellent organisational and time management skills.
* Solid presentation skills and ability to confidently pitch products and solutions.
* Familiarity with sales targets, pipeline management, and CRM systems such as Salesforce (training provided).
* Fluent in both Arabic and English.
* Ability to travel internationally for events.

**Desirable:**

* Experience working with Saudi clientele or local markets.
* Background in events sales, with varied industry knowledge.
* Innovative and confident approach to business development.

## Additional Information

**Please note this is a temporary freelance role with a duration of 8 months.**

ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Deployment Strategist Lead, you'll be fully responsible for opening up a new market for ElevenLabs, and building a team to make it happen. This is a senior position in which you’ll operate as if a co-founder, working alongside an experienced sales leader, of an effective startup moving from 0 -> 1 within our broader org, aiming to deploy our voice AI technology at the most Strategic customers in the market against their most challenging problems. All the while you’ll be able to leverage support from the rest of ElevenLabs to accelerate.

You will be responsible for hiring the team you need, winning the first customers in the market and ensuring that our product generates impact for them.

No two days are the same, but you should expect to:

- Meet with strategic customers to understand their critical audio and voice AI needs and locate their biggest pain points.

- Build and lead a team of forward deployed engineers within the region.

- Identify relevant use cases through deep engagement with customer problems and workflows, and work with Engineers to implement our voice and audio AI technology into innovative solutions.

- Design and architect bespoke integrations for customers, ensuring our technology fits seamlessly into their products and operations.

- Guide customers on best practices for implementing our voice and audio AI models to maximize their effectiveness.

- Present the results of our work and proposals for future work to audiences ranging from technical teams to C-suite executives.

- Collaborate with our Research and Product teams to incorporate field insights into ElevenLabs' software products and AI models.

- Build and deliver compelling demos of our voice and audio AI technology to new and existing customers.

- Scope out potential applications in new industries and expand our AI solutions across different sectors globally.

- Take full ownership of end-to-end execution of major projects for our most strategic partners, working hands-on to deliver high-impact solutions.

- Collaborate daily with our customers' engineering and executive teams to ensure optimal implementation of ElevenLabs' technologies.

REQUIREMENTS

- Executive Stakeholder Engagement: Proven experience engaging and influencing C-suite and VP-level stakeholders, both internally and at customer or partner organizations.

- People Leadership: Demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and manage high-performing technical teams while fostering a collaborative and results-driven culture.

- Basic proficiency in Python and understanding of API integration to implement scripts and help with prototyping/demo building.

- Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, especially in terms of ability to summarize complex technical concepts and using logic in pursuing optimal solutions.

- Technical aptitude to quickly understand our voice and audio AI models and their applications.

- Strategic and Commercial Awareness: Ability to align technical strategy with business objectives, with an understanding of deal structures, go-to-market motions, and revenue impact.

- Nice to have: Partner Ecosystem Development - Experience identifying, building, and nurturing relationships with system integrators, resellers, and technology partners to drive market growth.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Saudi Arabia or UAE. Expect regular travel for customer onsites. Fluency in English and Arabic and a deep understanding of the regional and cultural nuances is required.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Project Quality Specialist** to join our team!

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Support the implementation of the Project Quality Management System and Project Quality Plan.
* Monitor compliance with approved quality procedures, specifications, standards, and contractual requirements.
* Conduct routine quality inspections, surveillance activities, and quality audits.
* Review Method Statements, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), checklists, and quality procedures.
* Monitor Contractor and Subcontractor compliance with approved quality requirements.
* Review Material Inspection Requests (MIRs), Work Inspection Requests (WIRs), test reports, certificates, and quality records.
* Verify that materials, equipment, and workmanship comply with approved requirements.
* Monitor inspection and testing activities and ensure required Hold Points and Witness Points are properly managed.
* Identify quality risks, defects, non-conformances, and recurring quality issues.
* Raise, review, and monitor Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) and quality observations.
* Support root cause analysis and development of corrective and preventive actions.
* Follow up on corrective actions and verify closure based on objective evidence.
* Monitor quality performance and identify trends requiring management attention.
* Participate in Client, Consultant, Contractor, and internal quality inspections.
* Support internal and external quality audits.
* Maintain quality registers, inspection records, audit reports, NCR logs, and corrective action trackers.
* Support quality meetings, workshops, and technical coordination sessions.
* Provide technical quality advice to Construction and Engineering teams.
* Support investigation and resolution of construction quality issues.
* Ensure quality records are properly maintained and traceable.
* Support preparation of weekly and monthly quality reports.
* Participate in lessons-learned and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Promote a proactive quality culture across the project.

## Construction Quality Responsibilities

* Monitor quality of civil, structural, architectural, MEP, infrastructure, and specialist construction activities as applicable.
* Conduct site inspections to verify compliance with approved drawings, specifications, and Method Statements.
* Monitor workmanship and construction practices.
* Verify that required inspections and tests are completed before proceeding to subsequent activities.
* Review laboratory and field test results.
* Monitor material delivery, inspection, storage, handling, and traceability.
* Identify defective or non-compliant work and coordinate corrective actions.
* Monitor rework and recurring defects and provide recommendations to prevent recurrence.
* Support inspection and approval of completed works.
* Monitor punch-list and snagging activities and ensure timely closure.

## Engineering & Design Quality Support

* Support quality reviews of engineering and design deliverables.
* Verify that technical submissions comply with project quality requirements.
* Support design audits and technical quality reviews.
* Track design comments, observations, and corrective actions.
* Monitor implementation of approved design changes and revisions.
* Coordinate with Engineering and Design teams to resolve quality-related technical issues.
* Support verification that construction activities are based on the latest approved drawings and documents.

## Airport / Infrastructure & Airfield Responsibilities

* Support quality activities across airport terminals, airfield infrastructure, runways, taxiways, aprons, roads, utilities, MEP systems, and external works.
* Monitor quality requirements for airside and landside construction activities.
* Support quality inspections in restricted and operational airport environments.
* Coordinate quality requirements across multidisciplinary infrastructure interfaces.
* Monitor quality of critical civil, infrastructure, building, and specialist airport works.
* Support testing, commissioning, and handover quality requirements.
* Ensure project-specific airport, Client, Consultant, authority, and technical requirements are incorporated into quality inspections.

## Inspection & Testing

* Review and monitor ITPs and inspection procedures.
* Coordinate inspections with Contractors, Subcontractors, Consultants, and Client representatives.
* Verify compliance with approved inspection and testing requirements.
* Review material certificates, laboratory results, calibration certificates, and test reports.
* Track failed inspections and tests and ensure corrective action is implemented.
* Maintain accurate inspection and testing records.
* Support quality verification of completed works prior to handover.

## NCR & Corrective Action Management

* Monitor NCR and quality observation registers.
* Review NCRs and verify proposed corrective actions.
* Support root cause analysis for significant quality issues.
* Track corrective and preventive actions through to closure.
* Verify closure documentation and supporting evidence.
* Identify recurring quality issues and recommend preventive measures.
* Support trend analysis of NCRs, defects, and inspection failures.

## Quality Audits & Reporting

* Support preparation and execution of quality audit programs.
* Conduct process and compliance audits under the direction of the Project Quality Manager.
* Prepare audit findings and follow up corrective actions.
* Monitor Contractor and Subcontractor quality performance.
* Prepare weekly and monthly quality reports.
* Monitor key quality indicators, including:
    * NCRs
    * Quality Observations
    * Inspection Pass Rate
    * Test Failures
    * Rework
    * Material Rejections
    * Audit Findings
    * Corrective Action Closure
* Provide early warning of significant quality risks and recurring issues.

## **What Required Skills You’ll Bring**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Quality Management, or a related discipline.
* Minimum **5 years of relevant experience** in project quality, QA/QC, quality assurance, or construction quality management.
* Experience on major construction, infrastructure, airport, or multidisciplinary projects is preferred.
* Good understanding of construction quality management systems and QA/QC processes.
* Experience with ITPs, Method Statements, WIRs, MIRs, NCRs, inspections, and testing.
* Good understanding of construction materials, workmanship, and inspection requirements.
* Experience working with Contractors, Subcontractors, Consultants, and Client representatives.
* Good knowledge of ISO 9001 quality management principles.
* Experience with quality audits and corrective action management.
* ISO 9001, CQI, or equivalent quality certification is an advantage.
* Strong communication, reporting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

## **What Desired Skills You’ll Bring**

* Project Quality Management
* Quality Assurance
* Quality Control
* Construction Quality
* Quality Inspection
* ITP Management
* Material Inspection
* Testing & Inspection
* NCR Management
* Corrective & Preventive Actions
* Root Cause Analysis
* Quality Auditing
* Contractor Quality Management
* Quality Documentation
* Quality Reporting
* Compliance Monitoring
* Continuous Improvement
* Technical Coordination
* Problem Solving
* Stakeholder Coordination

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an exceptionally talented **Project Sustainability Manager** to join our site-based construction supervision team on a major public realm development in Diriyah, which includes a series of iconic and neighborhood parks, open spaces, and over 55 kilometers of streetscape. The objective of this program is to create a vibrant, inclusive environment that enhances livability, accessibility, and community well-being.

What You’ll Be Doing

* Report to the Project Director/Construction Director and act as the project lead for environmental management and sustainability on site.
* Develop, implement, and oversee the Project Environmental Management Plan and Sustainability Plan in line with Parsons standards, client requirements, and applicable regulations.
* Review and approve the contractor’s Environmental & Sustainability Plans, CEMP, Waste Management Plan, Pollution Prevention Plan, and related procedures, ensuring alignment with project objectives.
* Monitor construction activities to ensure compliance with local environmental regulations, permit conditions, and sustainability targets (e.g., resource efficiency, waste reduction, carbon considerations).
* Conduct regular environmental and sustainability inspections and audits on site, identifying non‑conformances and ensuring timely corrective and preventive actions.
* Oversee management of waste, noise, dust, air quality, water usage, soil protection, ecology, and hazardous materials in accordance with project standards.
* Coordinate environmental monitoring activities (e.g., noise, dust, water quality) and review monitoring reports, ensuring appropriate actions are taken as needed.
* Collaborate with HSE, construction, and design teams to integrate sustainability principles into construction methods, materials selection, waste handling, and site logistics.
* Support implementation of sustainability rating system requirements (e.g., LEED, Envision, or equivalent), including documentation, evidence gathering, and liaison with independent assessors, as applicable.
* Provide technical guidance to Parsons and contractor teams on environmental best practices and sustainable construction solutions.
* Lead or participate in environmental incident investigations, root-cause analysis, and reporting, and track implementation of corrective actions.
* Prepare and deliver training and toolbox talks on environmental and sustainability topics to project staff and contractor personnel.
* Coordinate with client representatives, regulatory authorities, and third-party auditors on all environmental and sustainability matters, including inspections and reporting.
* Manage project environmental and sustainability reporting, including weekly/monthly reports, KPI dashboards, and summary presentations for internal and external stakeholders.
* Ensure that environmental risks and opportunities are identified early, assessed, and incorporated into project risk registers and mitigation plans.
* Support handover and close-out activities by verifying environmental commitments are fulfilled, documentation is complete, and sustainability targets/credits are properly evidenced.

**What Required Skills You’ll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Sustainability from a recognized university.
* In environmental management and/or sustainability on large-scale construction or infrastructure projects, preferably in a site-based role.
* Strong knowledge of environmental regulations, standards, and permitting requirements applicable to construction projects in KSA or the GCC.
* Demonstrated experience implementing Environmental Management Systems and sustainable construction practices on major projects.
* Experience with green building/sustainability rating systems (e.g., LEED, Envision, BREEAM, Mostadam or similar); relevant accreditation or certification is preferred.
* Proven ability to lead environmental and sustainability programs, conduct audits, and influence contractor performance.
* Strong communication, coordination, and report-writing skills, with the ability to interface confidently with clients, regulators, and contractors.
* Familiarity with HSE management systems and the integration of environmental and sustainability requirements within overall project HSE frameworks.
* Experience in KSA or the GCC region is preferred.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Cost Engineer (Saudi National)** to join our team!

The Cost Engineer will support the planning, monitoring, control, and reporting of project costs across the Airport / Infrastructure / Airfield project. The role will ensure that project costs, commitments, variations, forecasts, and commercial changes are accurately monitored and reported against the approved budget and project baseline.

The position will work closely with the Commercial, Contracts, Planning, Procurement, Engineering, Construction, Project Controls, Finance, Contractors, and Client teams to maintain effective cost control and provide accurate financial visibility to project management.

## Key Responsibilities

* Monitor and control project costs against the approved budget.
    
* Maintain accurate cost reports and cost control systems.
    
* Monitor actual costs, commitments, accruals, forecasts, and budget movements.
    
* Prepare regular cost reports for Project Management and senior management.
    
* Maintain the Project Cost Breakdown Structure (CBS).
    
* Monitor costs by package, discipline, workstream, and project area.
    
* Track commitments and actual expenditure.
    
* Monitor approved and pending Variations / Change Orders.
    
* Assess cost impacts of design changes, Client instructions, and project changes.
    
* Support preparation of cost estimates and forecasts.
    
* Identify cost trends, risks, and potential overruns.
    
* Provide early warnings on potential budget impacts.
    
* Coordinate with Commercial and Contract teams regarding claims and variations.
    
* Reconcile cost reports with Finance and Commercial records.
    
* Support monthly project cost forecasting and reporting.
    

## Cost Control & Monitoring

* Establish and maintain cost control procedures.
    
* Monitor:
    
    * Approved Budget
        
    * Actual Cost
        
    * Committed Cost
        
    * Accrued Cost
        
    * Forecast Cost
        
    * Remaining Cost
        
    * Variations
        
    * Contingency
        
    * Potential Changes
        
* Monitor budget transfers and cost movements.
    
* Review cost performance against approved budgets.
    
* Identify cost variances and investigate causes.
    
* Prepare variance analysis and management commentary.
    
* Ensure cost information is accurate, timely, and traceable.
    

## Variations & Change Management

* Maintain the project Variation / Change Register from a cost perspective.
    
* Review cost impacts of Client instructions and design changes.
    
* Prepare or support preparation of cost estimates for variations.
    
* Review Contractor variation submissions.
    
* Validate quantities, rates, resources, and supporting documentation.
    
* Coordinate with Contracts and Commercial teams on variation assessments.
    
* Track:
    
    * Proposed Variations
        
    * Submitted Variations
        
    * Under Review
        
    * Approved Variations
        
    * Rejected Variations
        
    * Pending Client Approval
        
* Monitor the financial impact of approved and pending changes.
    
* Ensure approved changes are reflected in the project forecast.
    

## Forecasting

* Prepare monthly cost forecasts.
    
* Maintain Estimate at Completion (EAC).
    
* Monitor Estimate to Complete (ETC).
    
* Identify forecast movements and cost risks.
    
* Assess potential cost exposure from outstanding changes and claims.
    
* Coordinate with Planning and Commercial teams to align cost and schedule forecasts.
    
* Provide management with forward-looking cost information.
    
* Support development of recovery and mitigation strategies where cost risks are identified.
    

## Contractor & Subcontractor Cost Management

* Review Contractor and Subcontractor payment applications.
    
* Monitor commitments and contractual values.
    
* Support assessment of progress payment applications.
    
* Validate quantities and reported progress against approved records.
    
* Coordinate with Quantity Surveyors and Commercial teams.
    
* Monitor Contractor variations and claims.
    
* Track approved and pending commercial changes.
    
* Identify discrepancies between physical progress and reported cost.
    
* Support reconciliation of Contractor accounts.
    

## Project Controls Integration

* Coordinate closely with Planning Engineers and Project Controls teams.
    
* Integrate cost information with project schedule and progress data.
    
* Support development of **Earned Value Management (EVM)** where applicable.
    
* Monitor:
    
    * Planned Value (PV)
        
    * Earned Value (EV)
        
    * Actual Cost (AC)
        
    * Cost Variance (CV)
        
    * Schedule Variance (SV)
        
    * CPI / SPI
        
* Analyze cost performance and trends.

### Job Description – Upper Grades Chemistry Teacher

**Position:** Upper Grades Chemistry Teacher  
**Location:** Jeddah, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia  
**Reporting To:** Head of Secondary (Line Manager)  
**Start Date:** August 2026

### 1\. The Institution & Role Context

Our South Campus is undergoing a significant **STEM-focused academic and pedagogical transformation**, supported by substantial investment in state-of-the-art science laboratories and learning infrastructure.

We are seeking an experienced and highly qualified **Upper Grades Chemistry Teacher** who can leverage these facilities to deliver engaging, practical, and academically rigorous Chemistry instruction while driving strong student outcomes in external examinations.

The successful candidate will play a key role in strengthening practical science education and embedding laboratory-based learning as an integral part of the Chemistry curriculum.

### Reporting & Collaboration Structure

The position reports directly to the **Head of Secondary**, who serves as the Line Manager and is responsible for day-to-day operations, performance management, and professional development.

The Chemistry Teacher will also work closely with:

* **STEM Director:** Practical laboratory planning, scheduling, resource utilization, and STEM initiatives.
* **Academic Director:** Curriculum alignment, academic standards, assessment expectations, and student attainment.

### 2\. Core Responsibilities

### Teaching & Laboratory Execution

* Deliver high-quality **IGCSE and A-Level Chemistry** instruction aligned with the UK Curriculum and relevant examination board requirements.
* Provide a strong and consistent emphasis on **hands-on laboratory learning**, ensuring practical experimentation is embedded throughout the curriculum.
* Maximize the effective utilization of the school’s advanced laboratory facilities and resources.
* Design engaging lessons that develop students’ scientific inquiry, analytical thinking, problem-solving, and experimental skills.
* Prepare students effectively for practical components of external examinations.

### Student Attainment & Academic Performance

* Drive strong student performance and **pass rates in external board examinations**.
* Monitor student attainment and progress using internal and external assessment data.
* Identify learning gaps and implement targeted intervention and support strategies.
* Contribute to measurable **value-added student progress** across the Upper Grades.
* Maintain accurate records of student achievement, assessment, and academic progress.

### Laboratory Safety & Compliance

* Maintain strict adherence to recognized **international laboratory health and safety standards and protocols**.
* Ensure appropriate procedures are followed for the handling, storage, use, and disposal of chemicals and laboratory materials.
* Conduct appropriate risk assessments before practical activities.
* Promote a strong culture of laboratory safety among students and colleagues, with a commitment to **zero preventable safety incidents**.
* Ensure laboratory activities comply with school policies and applicable regulatory requirements.

### Curriculum & Academic Collaboration

* Collaborate with the Academic Director to ensure Chemistry curriculum delivery remains aligned with school standards and external examination requirements.
* Coordinate with the STEM Director regarding laboratory schedules, practical requirements, equipment, and resources.
* Participate actively in departmental planning, curriculum development, moderation, and academic review activities.
* Contribute to wider STEM initiatives, enrichment activities, science competitions, and interdisciplinary learning opportunities.

**Requirements**

### Job Requirements

### Qualifications

* Bachelor’s Degree in **Chemistry or a closely related field** from a recognized institution.
* Valid and recognized **teaching qualification or credential**.
* **PGCE, QTS, or equivalent postgraduate teaching qualification** is preferred.
* Recognized and up-to-date **laboratory safety certification**, such as **CLEAPSS or an internationally recognized equivalent**.
* Strong knowledge of **laboratory safety protocols, risk assessments, chemical handling, storage, and disposal procedures**.
* Strong subject-matter expertise in Chemistry.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong commitment to **academic excellence, student-centered learning, and continuous professional development**.

### Experience

* Minimum of **3 years of relevant teaching experience** in Upper Grades/Secondary Chemistry.
* Proven experience teaching the **UK Curriculum**, particularly **IGCSE and/or A-Level Chemistry**.
* Demonstrated experience in delivering **hands-on, laboratory-based Chemistry instruction**.
* Proven track record of supporting strong **student attainment and external examination outcomes**.
* Experience using assessment data to **monitor student progress, identify learning gaps, and implement targeted academic interventions**.
* Strong **classroom management and student engagement** experience.
* Experience working effectively within a **multicultural international school environment**.
* Previous experience in academically rigorous **UK Curriculum schools in the UK, South Africa, or high-performing international schools within the MENA region** is preferred.

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Medical insurance, as per company policy.
* Annual leave and flight ticket (Expat Employees).
* Professional development and career growth opportunities.
* Supportive, multicultural international school environment.

### **Job Description**

## Overview

The Project Director will provide overall leadership, strategic direction, and executive management, ensuring the successful delivery of multiple bridge and transportation infrastructure packages in accordance with client objectives, contractual requirements, budget, schedule, quality standards, and HSE commitments.

## Your role

**Project Leadership & Governance**

* Provide strategic leadership and overall management of the Project.
* Establish project objectives, execution strategies, and delivery plans aligned with client requirements.
* Lead multidisciplinary project teams including engineering, construction, project controls, commercial, quality, HSE, and stakeholder management functions.
* Ensure project governance frameworks are implemented and maintained throughout the project lifecycle.
* Drive project performance in relation to safety, quality, schedule, budget, and client satisfaction.
* Foster a high-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, and delivery excellence.

**Bridges & Infrastructure Project Delivery**

* Direct the planning, execution, monitoring, and completion of major bridge and transportation infrastructure works.
* Manage interfaces between bridge structures, highways, utilities, public realm works, and transportation systems.
* Ensure successful integration of engineering, construction, and operational requirements.
* Drive construction readiness and project execution strategies across multiple work fronts.

**Client & Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary executive interface with client and other key stakeholders.
* Lead executive meetings, steering committees, and project governance reviews.
* Ensure proactive communication with all stakeholders regarding project progress, risks, and key decisions.
* Represent the project during high-level client presentations and strategic discussions.

**Commercial & Contractual Management**

* Provide executive oversight of project commercial performance and contractual obligations.
* Monitor project budgets, forecasts, and financial performance.
* Support negotiation and resolution of major contractual and commercial issues.
* Ensure project delivery aligns with agreed commercial objectives and profitability targets.
* Maintain compliance with contractual requirements and governance procedures.

**Programme & Schedule Management**

* Ensure development and implementation of realistic and achievable project schedules.
* Monitor project progress against key milestones and delivery commitments.
* Lead recovery planning and mitigation strategies where delays or risks are identified.
* Review programme performance and direct corrective actions as required.
* Ensure coordination between design, procurement, construction, and commissioning activities.

**Engineering & Technical Oversight**

* Provide strategic direction on major engineering and construction decisions.
* Ensure technical compliance with project specifications, requirements of client, and international standards.
* Lead review and approval of significant design changes, construction methodologies, and technical solutions.
* Support resolution of technically complex bridge and infrastructure challenges.
* Promote innovation and best practices in project delivery.

**Risk Management**

* Establish and maintain project risk management frameworks.
* Identify strategic, commercial, technical, operational, and stakeholder risks.
* Ensure mitigation plans are developed and effectively implemented.
* Monitor emerging risks and opportunities throughout the project lifecycle.
* Lead risk review workshops and executive risk assessments.

**Health, Safety, Quality & Environmental Leadership**

* Champion a strong safety culture across the project.
* Ensure achievement of project HSE objectives and compliance with all regulatory requirements.
* Promote a Zero Harm philosophy throughout all phases of project delivery.
* Oversee quality management systems and ensure delivery of infrastructure assets to the highest standards.
* Ensure environmental and sustainability considerations are integrated into project execution.

**Team Leadership & Resource Management**

* Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing project management team.
* Ensure effective resource planning and allocation across project functions.
* Drive employee engagement, succession planning, and talent development.
* Foster collaboration across multidisciplinary teams and stakeholder groups.
* Promote continuous improvement and operational excellence.

**Project Controls & Reporting**

* Review executive dashboards and key project performance indicators.
* Provide strategic reports and recommendations to senior management and client representatives.
* Ensure transparency and accuracy in project reporting.

## About you

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
* Master's Degree in Engineering, Project Management, Construction Management, or Business Administration (MBA) is highly desirable.
* Chartered Engineer (CEng), Professional Engineer (PE), PMP, or equivalent professional accreditation preferred.
* Membership in recognized professional institutions such as ICE, PMI, ASCE, or equivalent is highly desirable.

**Experience Requirements**

* Minimum 20 years of experience in major infrastructure and transportation projects.
* Minimum 10 years in senior leadership or project director-level roles.
* Demonstrated responsibility for projects with values exceeding USD 500 million.
* Strong experience managing multidisciplinary teams in consultant, PMC, EPCM, or client organizations.
* Previous experience in Saudi Arabia and GCC infrastructure projects is highly preferred.

**Key Skills**

* Executive leadership and strategic planning.
* Large-scale infrastructure project management.
* Commercial and contractual management.

description: Oliver Wyman is looking for a seasoned professional as a Global Mobility Specialist to join our IMEA (India, Middle East & Africa) Mobility & Security team! This role will be based in our Riyadh office. Job Overview: The Global Mobility Specialist – IMEA supports the Global Mobility Manager – IMEA in delivering compliant, timely and employee focused Global Mobility services, primarily across Saudi Arabia, Qatar and Bahrain, with additional support across other GCC countries as required. The role is responsible for coordinating immigration and mobility activities, maintaining accurate records and supporting employees throughout relevant processes. It also provides related administrative support, including the preparation and issuance of employee letters and documentation. Working closely with HC Operations, Recruiting, Talent Management, business stakeholders and external service providers, the Global Mobility Specialist contributes to efficient and consistent employee experience while ensuring local requirements and Oliver Wyman policies are appropriately followed. Key Responsibilities: Manage day-to-day Global Mobility and immigration activities across Saudi Arabia, Qatar and Bahrain, with support for other GCC countries as required. Advise and support employees, candidates, Talent Management, project teams and other key stakeholders on immigration requirements for cross-border project staffing, business travel, onboarding and international transfers, coordinating required approvals and documentation. Manage immigration cases from initiation through completion, including residence permits, Iqamas/QIDs, work authorization, business visas, renewals, transfers and cancellations, providing clear guidance on requirements, documentation, fees and timelines. Support in-country processes, including medical examinations, biometrics and business visa health insurance, as well as relocation processes and applicable benefits, coordinating with HC Operations and relevant external vendors as required. Monitor immigration regulations, restrictions and process changes, assess their impact/risk on employees and project staffing as well as the OW organization, and ensure relevant stakeholders, guidance and Oliver Wyman internal communication templates/sites are updated accordingly. Prepare and issue immigration, mobility and employee documentation, including required letters and certificates, and provide related administrative support to the Global Mobility Manager and HC team, including document coordination, tracking, filing and attestation. Maintain accurate and confidential immigration and relocation records, databases and trackers, monitor visa, residence and work permit expiry dates, and proactively coordinate renewals and required follow-up actions. Collaborate with internal stakeholders, cross regional Global Mobility colleagues, immigration providers, government relations representatives and other service providers to resolve cases and ensure effective service delivery. Experience Required: Bachelor’s degree with 2–3 years of relevant professional experience, or 3–4 years of relevant experience in lieu of a degree. Minimum 2–3 years of experience in Global Mobility, Immigration, HC Operations or a related field, with GCC immigration experience, particularly in Saudi Arabia, Qatar and Bahrain, preferred. Strong proficiency in Arabic and English, written and spoken, is required. Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office; experience with HC, Global Mobility or case-management systems is advantageous. Skills & Behaviors: Strong client-service orientation, with a focus on delivering positive and professional employee experience, managing expectations and communicating effectively across all levels of the firm. Excellent organizational, prioritization and follow-up skills, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple cases, competing priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Self-starter with a strong sense of ownership and accountability, able to work independently while exercising sound judgment. Practical problem solver with a proactive, can-do mindset and a willingness to identify opportunities for process improvement. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build effective relationships and collaborate across functions, levels, cultures and geographies. Demonstrate discretion and professionalism when handling confidential or sensitive employee information. Curious, adaptable and learning-oriented, with the flexibility to respond to evolving regulatory, business and mobility requirements. Oliver Wyman Values: The Global Mobility Specialist is expected to demonstrate Oliver Wyman's values through their day-to-day work: Be Brave – Raise risks and concerns appropriately and constructively challenge processes where improvements can be made. Lead with Heart – Engage employees and colleagues with empathy, transparency and respect. Strive for Breakthroughs – Bring curiosity and rigor to continuously improve processes and the employee experience. Work as One – Collaborate effectively across Global Mobility, HC, Recruiting, the business and external partners. Own Our Impact – Take accountability for quality, accuracy, confidentiality, compliance and timely delivery. Oliver Wyman is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective.
